name: HMAC Generator
description: Generate an HMAC-SHA1/256/384/512 digest from a message and secret key using your browser's Web Crypto API — for webhook signatures, signed API requests, and testing.

faq.question: What's HMAC used for?
faq.answer: Verifying both the integrity and the origin of a message — common uses include webhook payload signatures (e.g. Stripe, GitHub sign their webhook bodies this way), signed API request authentication, and JWT's HS256/HS384/HS512 algorithms. The receiver recomputes the HMAC with the shared secret and checks it matches.

faq.question: Is this computed securely?
faq.answer: Yes — via your browser's native Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.sign with an HMAC key), the same implementation used for real cryptographic operations in the browser, not a hand-rolled reimplementation. Nothing you type is sent anywhere; verified in this tool's test against a real RFC 4231 test vector.
